Who We Are

Exploration, reimagined
from the air.

FLIGHTEC engineers innovative applications for Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS). Our rapidly deployable, scalable drones deliver fast, precise data collection with reduced costs and minimal environmental impact. Safe, autonomous, low-altitude flights ensure exceptional data quality and enable access to challenging, previously unreachable terrain. We combine cutting-edge technology with a deeply customer-centric approach.

Our Approach

Above. Below. Beyond.

Above
Unhindered. Unlimited.

Our aircraft reach terrain and conditions ground crews can't. We help you cover more ground, in less time, with consistent data quality across even the most remote and rugged exploration areas.

Below
Depth of Expertise.

Behind every flight is a specialised team fluent in the geophysics beneath it. From magnetic and radiometric survey design to full 3D inversion. We turn raw data into a model you can explore.

Beyond
Tomorrow's Technology, Today.

We design and engineer our own UAS platforms, keeping pace with and often keeping ahead of the technology shaping the future of exploration.

Capability

Services built for the ground
you haven't reached yet.

Magnetic Surveys

High-resolution aerial magnetic data to map subsurface geology and locate mineralised structures invisible at the surface.

Radiometric Surveys

Natural gamma-ray mapping that reveals surface geology, alteration zones and lithological boundaries across a site.

Topographic Mapping

Precise, drone-derived elevation models and terrain data for exploration planning, engineering and site design.

Volumetric Mapping

Accurate stockpile, pit and excavation volumes captured in a fraction of the time of ground-based methods.

Wireline Logging

Downhole geophysical logging that ties surface survey data to what is actually happening below it.

Full 3D Magnetic Inversion

Advanced modelling that turns magnetic survey data into a three-dimensional picture of the subsurface.

Turnkey UAS Development & Engineering

Custom unmanned aircraft systems engineered around the mission, from concept through to deployment.
